name: @qu/space-editor-prosemirror
description: Qu V5: an OPTIONAL ProseMirror-based rich text editor - never a dependency of @qu/app-shell/@qu/space-ui, an app opts in by installing and importing THIS package directly. bindLocalRichText() is a drop-in upgrade for @qu/space-ui's own bindRichText() (same {refresh, stop} contract, mirrors into a <textarea>'s .value, no networking). bindCollabRichText() binds y-prosemirror's ySyncPlugin straight to a @qu/space-core 'richtext'-shape field's own Y.XmlFragment (field.yxml) for real multi-peer live collaborative editing over the actual Space/relay sync - no fake cursor-presence layer (scope cut, content sync only).
